package.name: epistemic_slam
package.description:
The collaborative layer over SLAM Toolbox. Not a SLAM implementation: slam_toolbox builds each robot's map, and this package answers the question it does not, which is who knows what.
Two things live here. Per-robot bookkeeping of which regions a robot has actually observed, as opposed to which regions exist in a merged map it was handed. And the fusion that runs when two robots restore a link: reconciling their maps, deciding what each of them now knows, and telling the epistemic state about it. That is section 3.12.2 of the thesis, and CU-03.
Turning one robot's occupancy grid into epistemic atoms is a different job and is not done here. That is the extraction and translation of section 3.7, and it belongs in eplansys as plansys2_epistemic_perception: a bridge from a map to a knowledge model is useful to anyone with a map, and is not specific to this research.
